title: Feedforward Artificial Neural Network-Based Colorectal Cancer Detection Using Hyperspectral Imaging: A Step towards Automatic Optical Biopsy.
summary: The study included 54 consecutive surgical patients; leave-one-patient-out evaluation reported 86% sensitivity and 95% specificity for cancer/adenoma distinction. The cohort is small and the result is a diagnostic feasibility study; prospective external clinical performance is not established.
ai_technology: A four-layer feedforward neural network classified hyperspectral tissue annotations to distinguish colorectal cancer, adenoma and healthy samples.
